newsitem.title: ITALY: Ciga sees return to profits in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Ciga sees return to profits in 1996.

text.p: Italian hotel group Ciga, controlled by ITT-Sheraton, on Thursday reported a net consolidated profit of 9.1 billion lire for 1996 after a loss of 30.7 billion in 1995 and a larger loss of 224 billion in 1994.
In a statement, the group said 1996 sales were 636 billion lire, down four percent from 1995 after the sale of some hotels.

The group reported progress in the first quarter of 1997 with its average price per room up 6.7 percent at 286,000 lire but the rate of occupancy fell to 58 percent from 61 percent due to construction work in progress in some hotels.
Group debt at end-March 1997 was 307 billion lire compared to 1.1 trillion lire in 1994.
